headers.//: Vercel already serves everything as max-age=0, must-revalidate, which is right for the files that keep their name across builds: index.json, project.json, both HTML entries, and all of sb-manager / sb-addons / sb-common-assets. Stated explicitly so a future change cannot loosen it by accident.

Only /assets is safe to keep: those filenames carry a content hash (Accordion-dndm9R3d.css), so changed content means a new name. This is a load-time improvement, NOT a fix for stale content — it is listed second because Vercel applies matching rules in order.
